title: Implement the BYOL objective for comparison
prompt: Compute symmetric BYOL loss from two online predictions and two target projections of equal [B,D] shape. L2-normalize and average cross-view squared distances; stop gradients through targets. No contrastive negatives or DINO cross-entropy are used.
